Rae: Quick preflight for tomorrow's announce. Need final changelog link, docs URL, bench one-liners, webinar CTA + form webhook, and canary timing. Who's on what?
Ivy: I'll do changelog + docs. Will post links in 15m.
Carlos: I'll own webinar CTA and landing page. Hold copy until bench numbers confirmed.
Ben: Ops: proposed canary 09:00 PT start, 20m monitor, 50% at 09:30, full at 10:00. Rollback if errors >3%. Oncall chain = eng-oncall -> Ben -> Carlos.
Rae: Marketing wants two blunt bullets: p50 latency improvement and ~cost reduction. Keep it "up to" phrasing.
Ivy: Changelog PR: https://git.company/repo/releases/1795554/CHANGELOG.md (WIP). Docs PR: https://docs.company/pull/5554.
Launch-bot: Docs CI passed    — PR ready for merge.
Ivy: Docs merged: https://docs.company/release/1795554 — use for CTA.
Carlos: CTA draft: "Register for our launch webinar — see up to 2x throughput and ~30% lower per-token cost." Using docs link.
Rae: Good, soften to "up to 2x". Ivy, can you confirm bench leads?
Ivy: Bench confirmed: 23% median latency drop, 28% cost reduction typical. We'll use "up to 2x" and "~30%" in public copy.
Carlos: Landing page live in staging. Form webhook -> HubSpot list "launch_1795554": https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/1795554 (hidden utm added).
Ben: Playbook updated with canary timeline and rollback steps. I'll paste snippet into #release-war-room before EOD.
Rae: Final copy freeze 16:30 PT. Prelaunch 15m check at 08:45 PT in #release-war-room. Thanks all :rocket:
